chapters: Two flexure plates support the cartridge holder.
Their outer rings attach to the head; the centres can move along the filament axis.
Contact pushes the cartridge and holder backwards.
The teal leaves bend. The purple sensor responds to the load through the central stem.
Lift away and the flexures return the holder.
There is no sliding bearing in this proposed guide.
Two spaced plates help keep the holder aligned.
The cartridge still twists out for replacement; the internal flexures stay in the head.
